other_conditions: Applicant must be a domicile of Haryana having a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra ID
Applicant must not be employed in any public, government, private, quasi‑government or self‑employment at the time of applying
Applicant must be a graduate or post‑graduate (e.g., B.Tech, BCA, BSc IT, M.E., M.Tech, MCA, MSc IT, MBA IT) from a recognized institute
Unemployment allowance is available only if the candidate’s annual family income does not exceed ₹3 lakhs
Unemployment allowance commences one month after the issuance of the passing certificate for the assessment test
benefits_summary: Employment opportunities with monthly remuneration of ₹20,000–₹25,000 and a possible unemployment allowance of ₹10,000 for unemployed youths.
